title: Overview: Holographic Video Conferencing Pods
description: Booth-sized systems projecting life-size 3D holograms of remote people for meetings that feel in-person. The interface is where humans meet the digital world: better displays, audio, and input make technology disappear into everyday life. This database covers all the pieces needed to make it: core components, materials, processes, software, and subsystems, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Every record is the full entry with definitions, key facts, and a runnable demo program.

title: Signature design: Glossary & Quick Reference
description: Signature design: The working vocabulary of Holographic Video Conferencing Pods: Latency, Field of view, Haptics, Eyebox, Foveated rendering, SAR, Pairing, Firmware.
definition: Glossary for Holographic Video Conferencing Pods.
key_points: Latency: Delay between action and response — under 20 ms feels instant.
Field of view: How wide the display image appears to the user.
Haptics: Touch feedback: vibration, force, or texture simulation.
Eyebox: The region where the eye sees the full display image.
Foveated rendering: Rendering full detail only where the eye looks.
SAR: Specific absorption rate — regulated RF exposure limit.
Pairing: Connecting a device to a phone or computer wirelessly.
Firmware: Low-level software controlling the device hardware.
how_it_works: Learn the terms before the details.
Use the demo as a flash drill.
Add your own terms as you learn.
Teach the vocabulary to your team.
